Ember Sparks
Rank 2 WP 2 per power level

PrerequisiteEmber Grip

RequirementWord, gesture

Casting Time Action Range 10 meters Duration Instant

A shower of glowing sparks leaps from your fingers to a target and sets everything dry on it alight. The target takes D8 damage.

EffectFor each power level beyond the first: one more target within range.
